# 5 Letter Words

> Free word finders for Wordle, Scrabble, crosswords and other word games. 3 to 7 letter words, solvers, unscramblers and data-backed guides.

## Tools
- [5 letter word finder](https://5letterwords.se/): filter by right-spot, wrong-spot and excluded letters
- [Wordle solver](https://5letterwords.se/wordle-solver)
- [Word unscrambler](https://5letterwords.se/word-unscrambler)
- [Anagram solver](https://5letterwords.se/anagram-solver)
- [Word scramble solver](https://5letterwords.se/word-scramble)

## Reference
- [Word lists](https://5letterwords.se/word-lists): every length by first letter, last letter, contained letter, ending and pattern
- [Guides](https://5letterwords.se/guides)
- [Sources and methodology](https://5letterwords.se/sources-methodology)

## Note
Word lists vary by game. The base dictionary is ENABLE (public domain); check a word against your own game when it matters.
